about: AP Statistics concept dependency map (docs/apstat-spec.md, docs/apstat-phase0.md): the 55 topics of the revised CED in order, the "Math you need" skills with the topic each comes before, and every concept with the topic that teaches it, the concepts it depends on and, for notation, the TeX patterns that use it. Our own words; no CED text. Checked by scripts/check-apstat-map.mjs.

ced.edition: Revised course, effective fall 2026 (5 units, 55 topics)
ced.note: Built from docs/apstat-ced-map.json, itself from docs/apstat-research/framework.md. Objectives beyond Unit 2.1 unverified (docs/apstat-needs-author.md, ced-text).

chapters.title: Exploring One-Variable Data and Collecting Data

simulators.title: Data explorer: one data set as dotplot, histogram and boxplot; drag a point and watch mean vs median
Sampling lab: SRS, stratified, cluster and systematic samples from an illustrated population; bias made visible
Design randomizer: assign treatments, blocks and matched pairs with a seeded generator

frqThemes.title: Compare two distributions from boxplots and summary statistics, in context
A survey: choose between sampling methods, name the bias, write an investigative question
Design an experiment with blocking and explain what random assignment allows

stimulusThemes.title: A histogram and a boxplot of commute times

comparisonTables.title: SRS, stratified, cluster and systematic samples

pathways.title: From an investigative question to a data collection plan

chapters.title: Probability, Random Variables, and Probability Distributions

simulators.title: Probability trees: tree, two-way table and Venn diagram of the same events, linked
Distribution areas: shade a region under a normal curve or binomial histogram and read the probability

frqThemes.title: A binomial random variable defined in context: parameters, a probability and what it says about a claim
Conditional probability from a two-way table

stimulusThemes.title: A two-way table of survey responses (the probability set)
A probability distribution of a discrete random variable

pathways.title: Name the distribution, the parameters, the boundary and the direction

simulators.title: Sampling distributions (flagship): watch the distribution of a sample proportion or mean build sample by sample
Interval capture: 100 intervals from one population, coloured by whether they capture the parameter
p-value explorer: the null distribution, the shaded p-value, Type I and II errors and power
Chi-square lab: expected counts cell by cell, components as a heat map, the statistic on its distribution
Say it in context: conclusions, intervals, p-values and errors built slot by slot

frqThemes.title: A one-proportion z test, start to finish
A two-proportion interval and the claim it supports
Type I and Type II errors and their consequences in context

stimulusThemes.title: Computer output for a test of one proportion
Observed and expected counts in a two-way table

comparisonTables.title: Type I versus Type II error

pathways.title: State, plan, do, conclude for a test of a proportion

frqThemes.title: A paired t interval for a mean difference
A two-sample t test from summary statistics

stimulusThemes.title: Before and after measurements on the same subjects

simulators.title: Regression lab: drag points; the least-squares line, r, r squared and the residual plot update live

frqThemes.title: Interpret slope, r squared and a residual from computer output

stimulusThemes.title: A scatterplot with its least-squares line (the regression set)

comparisonTables.title: Outliers, high-leverage points and influential points

pathways.title: Describe, fit, check the residuals, interpret
